items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Oh, he was with me in '43, maybe early '44... I had Howard McGee

ctx.x: because I can't even tell you who else was in the saxophone section, except I think -- I'm not sure, but I think that Hymie Schertzer was in that band. I could be wrong, but I seem to remember him. Because that was a -- it was a very loose relationship. In other words, jobs weren't that often. We'd play something with Mildred, and then maybe I'd get a few one nighters and we'd load in the automobiles and take off and play them and come back. And sometimes the guys that played, like Mildred's jobs were maybe in a…
Okay, we got that one straightened out. How about Howard McGee, how did he happen to get in your band?
Well, we needed a trumpet player and Howard's a good trumpet player, and so we hired him.
